say:1:1331113801:1.text: When did that happen? I didn't even notice them coming in.
say:1:1331113801:1.source_cn: 什么时候离开的？我都没看到她们进来。
say:1:1331113801:1.male: When did that happen? I didn't even notice them coming in.
say:1:1331113801:1.female: When did that happen? I didn't even notice them coming in.

say:2:1331113802:1.text: The ceremony hasn't even started yet. Why did they leave?
say:2:1331113802:1.source_cn: 而且献花仪式还没开始，她们为什么要离开？
say:2:1331113802:1.male: The ceremony hasn't even started yet. Why did they leave?
say:2:1331113802:1.female: The ceremony hasn't even started yet. Why did they leave?
